Subject: Broken heater in apartment 4B

Dear Ms. Alvarez,

The heater in apartment 4B stopped working on October 2. I called you on October 3 to report it, and I haven't heard back since.

Overnight temperatures are now in the 40s °F, and the apartment is cold. Section 12 of our lease requires the landlord to provide heat.

Please repair the heater within 48 hours of receiving this email. If you can't do that, let me know in writing when a repair will happen. I'm keeping this email as a written record of my report.

Thank you for taking care of this promptly.

Sincerely,
